labkit.ui.runtime.createPortableFileReference

Describe an external file relative to saved state.

Syntax

function reference = createPortableFileReference(anchorFile, targetFile)

Usage

reference = labkit.ui.runtime.createPortableFileReference(anchorFile, targetFile)

Inputs

anchorFile
scalar text path of the project, snapshot, or autosave file.
targetFile
scalar text path of an external source file.

Output

reference
schema-1 struct with portable `relativePath`, fallback `originalPath`, and `fileName` fields. The relative path always uses forward slashes and may contain `..` components. Empty inputs produce empty path fields. The reference stores no file contents and performs no network access.
